text:
Ellen Park: heads-up 12 - Marketplace launch readiness check for Nimbus + SI integrations. need to confirm: hero assets, SI runbook, and embargo policy. timeline can't slip past Wed 07:00 PT.
Ravi Kumar: ops: we can meet that if we get final HW imagery + SKU mapping by EOD Mon. provisioning for a validation sandbox is queued.
Sofia Morales: marketing: suggested blog draft is at 80% - still waiting on a customer quote or vendor quote. can Nimbus provide a 1-2 sentence quote?
Devon Lee: SI: we'll need a short "how-to" (install + auth ~300 words) and an email for day 0 escalation. I'll draft the how-to and pair with the SI contact.
Ellen Park: PR question: embargo exception requested by one outlet. do we allow one NDA-protected hands-on?
PR-bot: policy note: one early hands-on can be allowed under NDA. PR must approve the outlet and legal must sign the addendum.
Sofia Morales: ok will coordinate NDA flow. who sends the NDA? legal or partnerships?
Ellen Park: partnerships will request; legal signs off. @Ravi please confirm sandbox network limits for NDA device testing.
Ravi Kumar: sandbox will have restricted egress, short-lived creds, and logs forwarded to a read-only bucket. need list of tester emails and approximate load (concurrent sessions).
Devon Lee: tester emails will be provided. load low - just smoke validation. also we need a small troubleshooting FAQ for the landing page. I'll include 3 bullet items.
Sofia Morales: creative needs two image variants (hero 1200x600 and marketplace banner 1024x256). Nimbus to deliver or we fallback to a product shot placeholder.
Ellen Park: fallback plan noted. timeline snapshot:
- Mon AM: final quote + images in repo
- Mon EOD: NDA signed for early hands-on (if used)
- Tue AM: sandbox provisioned + SI smoke tests
- Tue 17:00 PT: landing page staging cutover
- Wed 07:00 PT: blog + public announcement
- Wed 09:00 PT: marketplace listing go-live
Ravi Kumar: ops addition: add a post-launch throttle rule for first 48h to route heavy inference to dedicated pool. will add to playbook.
PR-bot: embargo list request: please DM outlet name to PR lead.
Ellen Park: any other blockers?
Devon Lee: request one more thing - can we add a short integration checklist link on the landing page (3 bullets + contact)? it reduces support load.
Sofia Morales: agree. will add `SI integration checklist` CTA next to docs link.
ops-bot: deployment reminder created: Marketplace staging deploy Tue 17:00 PT (approvers: eng-platform, partnerships, marketing).
Ellen Park: thanks all. I'll pull this into a single checklist and post link here after lunch.
